categories.name: Office Casuals
categories.description: Blazers, shirts and knitwear cut for a working day that runs long.
categories.bannerLine: Smart enough for the boardroom, soft enough for the drive home.
categories.blurb: Our office casuals are built around breathable cottons and lightweight wools. They hold a crease through a nine-hour day and still look right at a dinner.

categories.name: Blazers & Suiting
categories.description: Tailoring cut with precision. Half-canvas, soft shoulder, and a lapel that sits flat.
categories.bannerLine: The one garment worth tailoring properly, and the one we alter most often.
categories.blurb: Our blazers are half-canvased rather than fused, so they take a shoulder and contour naturally instead of bubbling after a season.

categories.name: Kurta Pajama
categories.description: Occasion sets in pure linen, raw silk, and cotton blends. Hand-finished for celebrations.
categories.bannerLine: For the wedding season, festivities, and every quiet gathering in between.
categories.blurb: Our kurta sets are finished by hand in our atelier workshop. Every set is pressed, checked, and ready to wear with custom alterations.
